guard: smoke teardown reaches only the recorded sandbox root, target-addressed down uses the same parsed space the CLI honors, and the guard runs before any environment-dependent live suite
why: This guard protects destructive smoke teardown from resolving through ambient operator state.
The mutations cover the independent ways that guarantee can be lost: directory identity can be
ignored, argv positions can replace parser semantics, repeated space flags can stop being last-wins,
a teardown call site can bypass the shared guard, or the proof can be removed from the check gate or
moved behind its first environment-dependent live suite. The ownership marker is a separate
identity from the root directory, so its mutations prove that removing or replacing it is
The empty-space mutation is the acceptance-boundary regression. The CLI treats an empty parsed space
as absent, so the guard must refuse it rather than verify the empty-space record and let the CLI act
on a different current mesh. Its expected failure names both argv cells because the separate empty
value and the repeated last-empty value reach the same parsed state through different routes.

mutations.name: M1 directory identity comparison accepts every observed root
mutations.find: observed.physicalPath === expected.physicalPath && observed.dev === expected.dev && observed.ino === expected.ino
mutations.expectRed: foreign sandbox root is refused by identity

mutations.name: M2 target routing scans argv position instead of parsed positionals
mutations.expectRed: generic guard refuses flag-before-target down web

mutations.name: M3 target space scans the first separate flag instead of using parser last-wins semantics
mutations.replace: const space = (() => { const i = args.indexOf("--space"); return i >= 0 ? args[i + 1] : undefined; })();
mutations.expectRed: target guard uses the CLI parser's last space value

mutations.name: M4 dogfood finally teardown bypasses the shared sandbox guard
mutations.replace: spawnSync(realNode, [tsxCli, binCotal, "down"], { encoding: "utf8", env, cwd: root });
mutations.expectRed: raw down spawn is not immediately guarded

mutations.name: M5 sandbox guard proof is removed from the check gate
M6 sandbox guard proof remains in check but moves behind the first live suite
mutations.find: pnpm smoke:core-boundary && pnpm smoke:sandbox-guard && pnpm smoke:spawn-from-anywhere && pnpm smoke:spawn-from-anywhere:live && pnpm smoke:connect
mutations.replace: pnpm smoke:core-boundary && pnpm smoke:spawn-from-anywhere && pnpm smoke:spawn-from-anywhere:live && pnpm smoke:sandbox-guard && pnpm smoke:connect
mutations.expectRed: check reaches smoke:sandbox-guard before its first environment-dependent live suite

mutations.name: M7 target guard accepts empty parsed space values that the CLI treats as absent
mutations.expectRed: target guard refuses both empty-space argv forms

mutations.name: M8 sandbox ownership marker identity is ignored
mutations.expectRed: missing sandbox ownership marker is refused by identity

mutations.name: M9 foreign sandbox ownership marker identity is accepted
mutations.expectRed: replaced sandbox ownership marker is refused as foreign

mutations.name: M10 target guard ignores the canonical document space field
mutations.expectRed: target guard refuses a canonical record whose space field is not the requested space
